name: Islamic Republic of Iran

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024. Surface area 1,745,150 km2 (AG.SRF.TOTL.K2); low is land area 1,622,500 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2).

population.note: asOf 2025 (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 92,417,681). Low -1% / high +1.5% for 2026 growth and estimate uncertainty.

activePersonnel.note: IISS Military Balance 2026 as quoted: 610,000 active on the personnel list (pp.347-352); the Iranian Armed Forces infobox quotes 523,000 (IISS unchanged since 2023, p.348). CIA Factbook 2025: up to 600,000. 6,000+ military killed in the 2026 war (US/Israeli claim) not material at this scale.

trainedReserves.note: IISS Military Balance 2026: 350,000 reserves. High adds the Basij mobilisable strength (~600,000 able to fight per the list footnote; claimed membership 12.6 million).

supportPersonnel.note: Active 580,000 minus infantry P roles (250,000). Covers Artesh navy (~18,000) and air/air defence (~40,000), IRGC Navy (~20,000), Aerospace Force (~15,000), Quds Force, armour/artillery crews and logistics (CIA Factbook 2025 breakdown).

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to Iran in the Iran-Iraq War (~1-1.2 million under arms incl. Basij from ~45-50 million, ~2.5%) scaled up for total war with a population of 92 million and a mass Basij structure.

count.note: Educated guess. Artesh Ground Forces infantry/mechanised divisions; CIA Factbook 2025 puts Artesh ground forces at ~350,000 incl. support and conscripts. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamic_Republic_of_Iran_Ground_Forces)

quality.note: Rubric 0.25-0.5: largely 1970s-80s equipment (T-72S, M60, Chieftain, BMP-1/2), domestic copies.

training.note: Rubric 0.5: conscripts (14-21 months) with basic training.

count.note: Educated guess. IRGC Ground Forces (CIA Factbook 2025: 100-150,000 incl. support) light/infantry brigades and commandos. Basij (90,000 active, 600,000 mobilisable) excluded. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamic_Revolutionary_Guard_Corps_Ground_Forces)

quality.note: Rubric 0.25-0.5: light infantry kit, some modern ATGMs/drones.

training.note: Rubric 0.5-0.75: IRGC cadres with Syria/Iraq combat experience; conscripts mixed in.

count.note: IISS Military Balance 2009 breakdown quoted on the Ground Forces article: 480 T-72S, 150 M60A1, 75 T-62, 100 Chieftain, 540 T-54/55/Type 59, 150 M47/48 (~1,495), plus ~150 Zulfiqar (IISS) and some Karrar. Ground forces were largely spared in the 2025-26 air campaigns; serviceability unknown.

quality.note: Rubric 0.25-0.5: obsolete tank park, no modern fire control or APS; Karrar is a T-72 derivative.

training.note: Rubric 0.5: conscript crews, limited live training under sanctions.

count.note: Educated guess. BMP-1/2, BTR-50/60, M113, Boragh, Rakhsh; no recent itemised count fetched. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamic_Republic_of_Iran_Ground_Forces)

quality.note: Rubric 0.25-0.5: mostly Soviet-era and domestic copies.

training.note: Rubric 0.5: conscript crews, limited live training under sanctions.

count.note: Educated guess. Large towed/SP tube park plus Fajr/Arash MRLs; IISS historically lists several thousand pieces incl. mortars (excluded). (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamic_Republic_of_Iran_Ground_Forces)

quality.note: Rubric 0.5 band minus: old tubes but capable long-range rockets (Fajr-5, Fateh-110 derivatives).

training.note: Rubric 0.5: conscript crews, limited live training under sanctions.

count.note: Educated guess. Pre-war ~240 combat aircraft (World Air Forces 2023 as quoted on the level-of-equipment list) incl. F-14, F-4, MiG-29, F-5/Saeqeh/Kowsar, F-7; two air campaigns (2025, 2026) destroyed aircraft on the ground and the IRIAF did not contest air superiority. Mid is a judgement of the flyable remainder, strike types split out. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_by_level_of_military_equipment)

quality.note: Rubric 0.25 (a generation behind): 1970s designs kept flying by cannibalisation; Su-35 deliveries unconfirmed.

training.note: Rubric 0.25-0.5: few flying hours under sanctions.

count.note: Educated guess. Su-24MK (two shot down by Qatar in 2026 per the war article), Su-22, Su-25 (IRGC), F-4 strike squadrons. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Iran_war)

Educated guess. Army aviation AH-1J (IISS 2009: ~50), CH-47C (~20), Bell 214/205/206, Mi-17; IRGC and navy helicopters; aviation losses in 2025-26 strikes (AH-1 destroyed per Twelve-Day War article). (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamic_Republic_of_Iran_Ground_Forces)

quality.note: Rubric 0.25-0.5: 1970s US types and Panha copies.

training.note: Rubric 0.5: conscript crews, limited live training under sanctions.

count.note: Educated guess. Reusable Group 2+ UAVs only (Shahed-129/149, Mohajer-6, Ababil-3, Kaman-22); Shahed-136 one-way attack munitions excluded although produced in thousands. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamic_Revolutionary_Guard_Corps_Aerospace_Force)

quality.note: Rubric 0.5-0.75: large, combat-proven drone industry, exported to Russia.

count.note: Navy inventory table (2026): Alvand class 0 (Alvand and Sabalan sunk, Alborz destroyed in dry dock), Moudge class 0 (four sunk; IRIS Dena sunk off Sri Lanka by USS Charlotte). High allows for the Makran/Shahid Mahdavi forward-base ships if still afloat.

Pre-war: Artesh Kaman FAC up to 10 (IISS 2026), ~16 patrol boats, ~17 landing ships/craft; IRGC Navy 1 surviving missile corvette (of 5), ~35 fast attack/torpedo boats, ~20 patrol boats, 5 landing ships, plus hundreds of small armed boats (excluded). Iran lost 155 vessels destroyed or damaged per the US/Israeli claim in the 2026 war infobox. Bayandor corvettes: 0 (two sunk).

quality.note: Rubric 0.25-0.5: swarming fast craft with anti-ship missiles; no air defence at sea.

training.note: Rubric 0.5: IRGCN trains for asymmetric swarm tactics.

count.note: Navy table (2026): Kilo class 0 operational (2 non-operational), Fateh 0 (lead ship sunk), Ghadir midget submarines 5+ remaining after 11 were destroyed by US strikes.

Ballistic missile launchers: IDF said 120 destroyed = 30% in June 2025 (implying ~400 pre-war; Twelve-Day War article), 200+ destroyed in that war; partial rebuilding; 190+ more destroyed in 2026 (US/Israeli claim, 2026 Iran war infobox) while a leaked US intelligence report (May 2026) said Iran retained ~70% of missiles and launchers. 70% of a rebuilt ~300-400 = ~210-280. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twelve-Day_War and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Iran_war

quality.note: Rubric 0.5-0.75: largest missile force in the region (Fattah, Kheibar Shekan, Emad), improving accuracy; many intercepted.

training.note: Rubric 0.5-0.75: IRGC Aerospace Force with combat salvos in 2024-26.

count.note: Educated guess. Pre-2025 network of ~150-200 batteries (S-300PMU2, Bavar-373, Khordad, Tor-M1, Hawk/Mersad, Rapier, AAA) heavily degraded: 120+ SAM launchers destroyed in June 2025 (Twelve-Day War article) and more in 2026; mid is the surviving remainder. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twelve-Day_War)

quality.note: Rubric 0.25-0.5: failed to contest Israeli/US air operations twice.

commandQuality.note: Rubric 0.25-0.5: dual Artesh/IRGC command; senior leadership incl. Supreme Leader Khamenei killed 28 Feb 2026, decentralised "mosaic defence" kept fighting but with limited control (war article).

cohesion.note: Rubric 0.5: national conscript army; IRGC ideologically cohesive, Artesh less so; regime under internal pressure after the 2025-26 protest massacres.

morale.note: Rubric 0.5-0.75: homeland under sustained attack (rally effect) vs heavy losses, economic collapse and internal repression.

weapons.note: Anchor 9-10: precision-guided ballistic missiles (Fattah, Kheibar Shekan), mass drones and loitering munitions; otherwise 1970s-80s weapons.

armor.note: Anchor 8-9: T-72S/Karrar with basic FCS, much older M47/T-55.

ships.note: Anchor 8-9: navy largely sunk in 2026; fast-attack craft with anti-ship missiles remain.

fortification.note: Anchor 9 hardened shelters: deep underground missile bases and Fordow; layered air defence destroyed.

logistics.note: Anchor 8-9: rail and road network, sanctions limit spares.

communications.note: Anchor 9: networked but disrupted command after leadership decapitation.

isr.note: Anchor 9: a few domestic satellites (Noor), drone ISR; poor early warning.

cyber.note: Anchor 10 partly: active state cyber units (IRGC-linked APT groups).

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 1,245,369,157,874 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD rebased x 0.8005) / population 92,417,681 = 13,475 2011 int$. Range +/-15%. War damage in 2026 not yet reflected in the 2025 figure. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 1,555,739,110,399 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 1,245,369,157,874 2011 int$. Range +/-15% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. War damage in 2026 not yet reflected in the 2025 figure. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank: 2.09% of GDP in 2025 (latest), 2.22% 2024, 2.49% 2023. No 2026 wartime figure; high is an educated allowance for war spending and off-budget IRGC revenues.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction (and hydrocarbons) 39.6% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-7% for oil-price swings.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Large wheat producer but net grain/feed importer; drought-prone.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 46,947,484 x share of males aged 15-19 7.106% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 667,224. Male population from SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN. Males only (conscript-pool convention). Range +/-10% for single-year cohort variation.

drones.note: Educated guess. Reusable Group 2+ UAVs only (Mohajer, Shahed-129/149); one-way Shahed-136 output is far higher.

missiles.note: Educated guess. Launcher (TEL) production; missile output (hundreds per year pre-war) was hit by strikes on Shahroud/Parchin-type plants.

artillery.note: Educated guess. Domestic MRL and tube production.

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 9,455 route-km (World Bank IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). CIA Factbook 8,483 km (2014). Several lines struck in 2026.

majorPorts.note: CIA Factbook 2024: 18 ports, 0 large, 4 medium; key ports Abadan, Bandar Abbas, Bushehr, Khorramshahr. Under US naval blockade at points in 2026.

merchantTonnage.note: asOf 2025: 21,080 thousand DWT under the Iranian flag (12,034 thousand GT). 9 IRGC-linked tankers destroyed or damaged in 2026 (war infobox); low allows for war losses and blockade.

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Truck-based; proxies supplied regionally via Iraq.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, donkeys, mules, camels; not from FAO data.

nuclearWarheads.note: Iran is not listed among the nine nuclear-armed states in the FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 table. Threshold programme: enrichment to 60% before the June 2025 strikes; IAEA has been unable to verify the HEU stockpile since Feb 2026 (2026 Iran war article). 0 warheads.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.3: deep strategic depth, Zagros/Alborz mountains, harsh climate, mass population (Basij) support - against a ground invader; no protection from air campaigns.

notes: WARTIME snapshot: 2026 Iran war with the US and Israel since 28 Feb 2026 (Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei killed; Mojtaba Khamenei named successor 8 March), following the June 2025 Twelve-Day War; ceasefires of April and June 2026 collapsed (8 July). asOf 2025 economic data, order of battle adjusted for 2025-26 losses where sources state them (navy table updated for the war; launcher counts per war infobox). All counts uncertain: IISS figures as quoted are often old editions (2009 tank breakdown). Paramilitary Basij (IISS 40,000; 600,000 mobilisable) and Law Enforcement excluded from active; Axis of Resistance proxies (Hezbollah, Houthis, Iraqi PMF) excluded. Population: everything inside ne:IRN (World Bank). Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011 (+/-15%). Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D).
